policy: The old standalone desktop PySide panels are retired. Promoted analysis interfaces live as notebooks under src/radia/panels/notebooks. The Cubit Export Mesh toolbar remains active as a Cubit-embedded mesh export surface. A panel is a light notebook wrapper around app-specific calc_*.py CLI arguments mapped into DesignSpec settings. Persistent initial values live in DesignSpec(...) notebook cells, while JSON files are run artifacts with radia_result metadata. Concise domain notes and pointers to previous in-repo result artifacts are part of the notebook panel contract.

panels.title: Radia IH Notebook Interface
panels.status: The IH notebook workbench is the canonical browser-native panel surface.
cells:
# Radia IH Notebook Interface

Source modules: `src/radia/ih_design.py` and `src/radia/ih_notebook.py`.

This notebook is the browser-native interface for induction-heating workflows.

from radia.ih_notebook import IHWorkbench

workbench = IHWorkbench()
workbench.display()

# Build the current command after editing the widgets.
# The Run button remains disabled until required inputs are present.
cmd = workbench.build_command()
cmd
